method: Unblinded inspection of every effective recorded tool input, command results and complete final source diff. Inert native JSON keys are retained separately. No source repair, gold recovery or verifier feedback.

decisions.name: 1-rounding-rename-baseline
decisions.notes: Complete recorded inputs reviewed: local reads/searches, one guarded rename, git diff/status only, then actual compiler and exact requested seven-file selection after the final edit. No external source/solution retrieval. The final changes are identifier-only and preserve all literals/assertions/paths; all ten sources satisfy the independent parser oracle. No root-star query occurred; validation admission and actual selected-suite success remain separate.

decisions.name: 1-rounding-rename-modified
decisions.notes: Every recorded input reviewed. Native rename once; final diff is byte-identical to reviewed baseline and passes the parser integrity oracle. Exact requested 136-pass/one-skip selection runs after edit. Compiler returns a running r2 handle, subsequently inspected: nested completed.data.exitCode=0 and passed source-bound typecheck. Only local rg/git inspections follow. No solution retrieval. Baseline and modified both avoid root-star searches; lower observed resources alone do not prove that scope guidance caused the difference.

decisions.name: 1-rounding-rename-cline
decisions.notes: All effective inputs inspected, including every patch and command. Initial patch changes a floor assertion and subsequent repair introduces an extra closing brace; actual compiler exits 2 and selected suite fails. The model reads its own initial task-input HEAD test to restore original assertions, then repairs the brace and independently reruns compiler and exact requested selection successfully after final edit. Own task-input HEAD is ordinary source inspection, not recovered solution/reference patch. Inert run_commands string key does not execute. Final full diff is byte-identical to both reviewed Light arms and passes the parser audit. Intermediate failures and self-recovery remain in traces.

decisions.name: 1-interval-local-control-modified
decisions.notes: All seven tool inputs and full one-file diff reviewed. Initial scoped patch includes an export prefix outside the aliased function projection and is blocked before mutation; a smaller precise patch succeeds. Exact requested compiler and seven-file selection pass after final edit (84 tests). Subsequent git inspection is read-only; no external source/solution retrieval. No search or native rename exposure: control overhead cannot be assigned to scope.

decisions.name: 1-interval-local-control-cline
decisions.notes: All effective inputs and full one-file diff reviewed. One exact patch, then actual compiler and requested seven-file selection both succeed in an AND command chain after final edit (84 tests). Remaining operations inspect only local source/git status; no source recovery or solution retrieval. Inert string metadata in run_commands is preserved and does not execute. Source matches both Light arms byte-for-byte.

decisions.name: 1-interval-local-control-baseline
decisions.notes: All five tool inputs and full diff reviewed. One precise scoped patch succeeds; project types executes the same compiler script as npm run types and returns exit zero. Exact requested seven-file command then passes 84 tests after final edit. No later source mutation, search exposure, rename exposure or solution retrieval. Same final source as both other arms.
